message.content: {"merge": false, "reason": "The two skills represent conflicting procedural logics for handling grounding results. Skill B ('Escalate...') explicitly instructs that an empty grounding result should NOT be treated as a negative finding, but rather triggers an escalation to the expert model to verify presence. Merging these would create a logical contradiction: one path dictates stopping and answering 'no' upon grounding failure, while the other dictates continuing to the expert. They are incompatible control flows for the same scope."}
